title: Little Girl Or Woman
paragraphs: “Oh, that reminds me…”

I used a portal to go buy some Filolials, but I realized something. I still haven’t shown that Filolial breeder how much Yuki-chan and the others have grown. I keep meaning to, but I never seem to have the time. Well, just like always, I got Yuki-chan, Kou, and Sakura-chan’s eggs.

As usual, the Filolial breeder was kind enough to sell them to me at a reasonable price. Just like how Father respects the old man at the weapon shop, maybe I should respect this breeder in the same way. Next time I have the chance, I’ll properly introduce Yuki-chan and the others.
“I’m back!”

When I returned to the inn, everyone was relaxing in their own way. Ren was in the corner of the room, taking care of his sword. A holy weapon doesn’t even need maintenance, you know? Itsuki was sitting on the bed, reading through a help manual, absorbed in its contents. Father was gazing out the window.
“Oh, welcome back, Motoyasu-kun! Just now, I saw beastmen that looked like pandas and elephants walking around!”
“Naofumi-san, you were getting all excited like a little kid.”
“But come on, pandas and elephants? Doesn’t that make you feel like you’re really in another world?”
“I get where you’re coming from, but think about Eclair. She was struggling to keep you in check when your eyes were practically sparkling.”
“My eyes weren’t sparkling!”
“You were practically glued to the window, and you say that?”
“So, Iwatani-dono likes beastmen, huh? I suppose that suits the Shield Hero.”
“Is that how it is?”
Oh? The atmosphere here has improved. Was it the pandas? Now that I think about it, there are panda beastmen in this country. Maybe I should try recruiting one if I get the chance?
“So? Did you get them?”
“Yes, indeed!”
I showed them Yuki-chan and the others’ eggs.
“Ohh… So these are Filolial eggs?”
“When will they hatch?”
“It looks like there’s an incubator, but won’t it take some time?”
“If I register them, they’ll hatch by tomorrow.”
“As expected of another world. That’s a pretty convenient tool.”
“So tomorrow they’ll hatch, Motoyasu will raise them… I guess we’ll be ready to fight by the day after tomorrow.”
“Well, with Eclair here, we should be able to go out a little, right?”
“That’s right. If possible, we should fight some weaker monsters tomorrow to get used to combat.”
“And tonight, we have a study session where Motoyasu-kun will teach us about strengthening methods. It’ll be a good chance to test things out.”
“I have some doubts… but let’s see what Kitamura-dono is capable of.”
Éclair stood up and started preparing to leave. I’ll make sure they get a good look at my strength.
“We’ll just stay here and keep a low profile so we don’t cause any trouble.”
“Yeah.”
“I really hope we don’t get ambushed, and this all turns into one of those traumatic memories for Motoyasu-san.”
“Ahaha… That’s not funny at all.”
“Yeah, we shouldn’t even joke about that.”

It’s been on my mind for a while, but I feel like Father and the others have become a bit more timid. What’s the reason for that? Ah, of course. It must be because they were nearly killed by that Trash and the Crimson Swine. They may be gone from this world now, but even in death, they still cause trouble.
“Now all that’s left is to register them and wait for them to hatch.”

I dripped my blood onto the monster crests carved into Yuki-chan and Kou’s eggs, completing their registration. The issue is with Sakura-chan. The time before last, I registered her and raised her myself. As a result, she turned into an angelic figure, just like Yuki-chan and the others.

But last time, for some reason, she grew to about Éclair’s height and looked a little older than Yuki-chan and the others. Perhaps if I register her, she takes on a younger appearance, while if Father registers her, she turns out more mature.
“This is Sakura-chan’s egg. So, Father, I have a question for you.”
“What is it?”
“What kind of person do you want Sakura-chan to become?”
“What do you mean?”
I explained to Father about the situation with Sakura-chan. In short, she could either turn out as a young girl or as an adult. A true ultimate decision.
“That’s something we wouldn’t know unless we looped through it.”
“Yeah. If it’s not the exact same individual, it’s hard to determine growth differences. That kind of thing happens in games too.”
“Like when you only realize the difference after backing up a save file?”
“Going by that logic, even if Motoyasu-kun got his hands on this ‘Filo’ kid’s egg, he wouldn’t know if it was the right one, right?”
“No, I can identify Filo-tan by her scent!”
“By scent…?”
“Naofumi, it’s Motoyasu we’re talking about.”
“Yeah, we’re dealing with someone ridiculously strong and crazy.”
“Good point.”
Understanding each other from the heart is a beautiful thing. I’m sure the Father from before would be pleased too.
“So? What do you want to do?”
“You’re asking if I should be the one to register Sakura-chan?”
“Hmm… A child who would protect me, huh? I mean, I already have Eclair, but…”
Father glanced over at Éclair.
“If possible, please do it for Sakura-chan’s sake.”

Sakura-chan always cherished Father. She was such a good girl, always following his instructions. Even when I raised her, in the end, she was most attached to Father. So, it would be best if he were the one to raise her this time as well.
“Alright, if Motoyasu-kun wants to entrust her to me, I’ll register her.”
Father registered Sakura-chan’s egg.
“I just need to take good care of this egg, right?”
“That’s right.”
“Huh… I’m really looking forward to seeing what kind of child hatches from this egg.”

I’m looking forward to it too. Last time, we had a sorrowful parting, but being able to meet again like this is truly a joy. Just thinking about spending time together with everyone again fills me with excitement.
“Motoyasu, don’t we get any?”
At that moment, Ren and Itsuki asked me. I counted the number of eggs and the people currently here. Yuki-chan will surely want to carry me.
I often rode on Yuki-chan’s back alone. Kou… well, it depended on the situation. Sakura-chan would carry Father, which means… oh?

Would Kou carry both Ren and Itsuki at the same time? It’s not impossible, but it would be cramped. Well, if we leave Ren and Itsuki’s leveling up to Yuki-chan, Kou, and Sakura-chan, there shouldn’t be a problem.
“In the end, they’ll be pulling the carriage, so there’s no issue.”
“Filolials like pulling carriages, right? Eclair-san mentioned that earlier.”
“Now that I think about it, what kind of creatures are they, really? There are so many things I’d like to question.”
“They didn’t exist in the game?”
“There were similar monsters, but they were a bit different.”
“Huh, interesting.”
“But still, only Naofumi-san got an egg, huh…”
“Motoyasu got one too.”
“Yeah, but…”
“If you want, I can look around to see if any are for sale. It’s a bit risky, but I’m good at business, so I could give it a shot.”
Father asked Ren and Itsuki. That’s a great idea. It would be wonderful if Father and the others actively tried to increase the number of Filolials.
“It’s not that important, so we’re fine.”
“Yeah, having too many would be troublesome anyway. For now, we should just confirm if Motoyasu-san’s words are true.”
Hmm, I see. Well, numbers shouldn’t be a problem.
Hmm… I should consider buying more later for better maneuverability. Come to think of it, I haven’t encountered Kuro-chan since my very first loop.

They’re a bit pricey at the monster merchant’s place, but should I look for one? But where in the world is Filo-tan’s egg? Last time, Father even made a reservation for it, yet we never found it. The time before that, I checked all the Filolial eggs at the monster merchant’s lottery tent, but still, nothing.

Where exactly did Father purchase it from? I should also think about what to do with Luna-chan. Now that I recall, Luna-chan’s colors were somewhat similar to Filo-tan’s. Her whole body was mostly white, but she had deep blue markings. She was completely blue when she was first born. There are so many mysteries surrounding Filolials. Luna-chan liked Keel.

Or rather, should I say she liked cute things in general? If we go to Faubrey, we could completely wipe out the Three Heroes Church. That should allow us to punish those slave traders while helping Éclair rebuild her territory. We could also take that opportunity to pick up Luna-chan and Keel.
…Considering what happened last time, we should resolve things as quickly as possible.
“Éclair.”
“Kitamura-dono! Learn to remember people’s names properly!”
“We need to strengthen Father and the others as soon as possible, head to Faubrey, and bring judgment upon the Three Heroes Church. If we don’t, more people in the territory will suffer.”
“Ah… yeah…”
“Sometimes, doesn’t Motoyasu-kun suddenly get all serious and say something completely reasonable?”
“Yeah. If only he were like that all the time.”
“I don’t doubt him, but there’s definitely a screw loose in his head.”
Alright, today’s plan is leveling up and boosting Éclair’s strength. She’s already quite strong, so we should challenge tougher opponents.
“Well then, Father and the others, please take it easy and rest up!”
Waving to Father and the others, I took Éclair out for a night of hunting.
